_comment: Air + Column -> a pillar of wind, rendered like the fire pillar's column trail but with the particle set in AirPillarEffect.trailParticle() (cloud) and no placed blocks. Only 'reach' (column length) is read here; the trail's particle/density are code-side. Shoves entities caught in it along the casting axis. Length/strength scale with SignBundle.count x Size x Power.
